completion_basis: Requested prerequisite branch: tested known command/integration mismatch and force feasibility between commands. Physical-parameter adaptation comparison was not performed.

hypothesis.measured_failure: Prior corrected pulse angular/joint-velocity one-step residual is 0.687720 rad/s despite initial force-row feasibility. The predictor uses initial executable torque for 20 ms; the plant executes a position/velocity/feedforward command throughout the interval.
hypothesis.prerequisite: Separate command realization and integration error from a physical-parameter mismatch before identifying friction, compliance or actuator lag.
hypothesis.hypothesis: Evaluating the known servo command along predicted states reduces angular/joint-velocity residual by at least 10 percent relative to 2 ms frozen-torque integration on both nominal selection data and the separate pulse condition.
variants: Frozen initial torque, one 20 ms step
Frozen initial torque, ten 2 ms predictor steps
Issued servo law evaluated at predicted states, ten 2 ms predictor steps
hypothesis.selection: Archived corrected nominal estimated transitions starting at 4.00 through 5.98 s; no physical parameter fitted.
hypothesis.reserved: Archived corrected pulse estimated transitions starting at 4.50 through 5.98 s; excluded from selection.
hypothesis.additional_measurement: Evaluate the previous command at the next estimated state before changing commands. Count loss of model cone feasibility despite feasible initial rows. This uses observed endpoints for scoring only.
hypothesis.controller_inputs: Only archived estimated states and issued commands. No future observations enter predictor trajectories. Known command gains and controller torque limits are retained.
hypothesis.hardware_ranges: None selected. Existing synthetic 10 mm/0.01 rad base bias and ideal joint/velocity channels are unmeasured hardware assumptions.
hypothesis.decision_rule: A failed command-model or between-command feasibility prerequisite completes this prerequisite question with measured limitations; do not attribute its residual to an identified physical parameter or report closed-loop adaptation benefit. A successful predictor alone also does not establish closed-loop benefit.

selection.decision: Do not select servo evolution as the dominant remaining error. Evaluate all three unchanged predictors on the preregistered pulse interval to measure transfer and interval feasibility. No fitting or parameter search follows.

decision.conclusion: The known servo law explains part of the residual but fails the nominal improvement criterion. Finer integration has the larger nominal effect. Initial feasible commands lose model feasibility at observed endpoints. No physical uncertainty range is identified.
decision.physical_parameter_fitting: Not performed: command/integration and contact-model prerequisites invalidate attribution to a physical mismatch.
decision.adapted_closed_loop_comparison: Not performed; all predictors score the same archived estimated states and commands.

hardware_validation_needed: Synchronized issued position, velocity and feedforward commands, measured current/torque and encoders, with samples inside each 20 ms interval.

future_experiment: Constrain the predicted command interval and evaluate every physical substep and the next estimated endpoint under one reserved disturbance; reject for persistent force violations, contact loss or solve-plus-update latency over 20 ms.
